bio.text: Anne Hughes, a Democrat, has represented Connecticut House District 135 since 2019.

According to Ballotpedia, she lived in Easton as of September 2019, earned a bachelor's degree in art and political science from the College of New Rochelle, and earned a master of social work at the University of New England in 2014.

Ballotpedia lists her work as a Licensed Master Social Worker for Jewish Senior Services' Institute on Aging and as Coordinator for the Center for Elder Abuse Prevention, and says she co-founded the Norwalk Peacemakers.
